user.title: Add a PanelOS panel
user.description: Adds a panel running PanelOS as a device with its display, settings and sensors, and sets what its dashboard and assistant modes show. The panel's voice satellite comes with the ESPHome integration and is shown as connected via this device.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.

dashboard.title: Dashboard mode
dashboard.description: The panel shows a Home Assistant dashboard in its web view, the same as in a browser, custom cards included.

data_description.dashboard: Which dashboard the panel shows. "Chosen on the panel" leaves it to the panel's own settings and its Dashboard entity.
data_description.show_header: The dashboard's top bar with its title and the tabs of its views. Without it the dashboard gets the whole screen, but its views can only be reached through links on the dashboard.
data_description.show_sidebar: Home Assistant's menu (all dashboards, settings and other pages). Without it the panel stays on the chosen dashboard.
data_description.zoom: How large the dashboard is drawn on the panel; below 100 % more fits on the screen.
data_description.loading_screen: While a dashboard loads, the panel shows its loading screen and reveals the dashboard once it is complete. Off: Home Assistant's own start-up shows instead and the dashboard appears while it loads, sooner but unfinished at first.
data_description.skip_unused_resources: With this on, the panel loads only the card resources the dashboard it shows needs, so it opens faster.
data_description.keep_resources: For a resource the dashboard needs although its name does not match any of its cards.

sensor_reporting.title: Sensor reporting
sensor_reporting.description: How much a sensor must change before the panel sends Home Assistant a new value. Every value sent is a row in the recorder's database (history, logbook, statistics). Lower numbers give finer history and quicker automations but more database writes; higher numbers mean fewer writes but only larger changes show up. The panel's own brightness, theme and Wi-Fi roaming do not depend on these.

data_description.illuminance_change: Change from the last value sent, in percent, and at least 5 lx, so the noise of a dark room is not sent. The panel checks the light twice a second and sends at most one change in 10 seconds, and the value again every 10 minutes. Lower: finer light history and automations that react to small changes. Higher: fewer writes; automations see only bigger changes.
data_description.soc_temperature_change: The processor temperature is read every minute and averaged over about five minutes; a new value is sent when the average moves at least this much. Lower: detailed temperature history. Higher: fewer writes; only larger warming or cooling shows up.
data_description.wifi_signal_change: The signal is read every minute and averaged over about five minutes; a new value is sent when the average moves at least this much. Lower: detailed history, useful for finding weak spots. Higher: fewer writes; short dips do not show up.

show_view.name: Show view
show_view.description: Shows a view on a PanelOS panel for a while.

panel_id.name: Panel
panel_id.description: The panel's ID, as in its PanelOS entry; empty = every panel.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: The camera for the camera view.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to show it; 0 = until someone touches the screen.

show_status.name: Show status screen
show_status.description: Shows a status screen that is started by an action (set on the PanelOS page) on the panels it is set for.

screen.name: Status screen
screen.description: The status screen's name in automations, as shown on the PanelOS page (e.g. toilet_occupied).

clear_status.name: Clear status screen
clear_status.description: Ends a status screen that was started by an action.

screen.name: Status screen
screen.description: The status screen's name in automations, as shown on the PanelOS page (e.g. toilet_occupied).

critical_alert.name: Start critical alert
critical_alert.description: Starts an own critical alert that is started by an action (set on the PanelOS page) on the panels it is shown on.

alert.name: Critical alert
alert.description: The critical alert's ID, as shown on the PanelOS page.

clear_critical_alert.name: End critical alert
clear_critical_alert.description: Ends an own critical alert that was started by an action.

alert.name: Critical alert
alert.description: The critical alert's ID, as shown on the PanelOS page.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Puts a notification on PanelOS panels: in their notifications list and in the new-notification window. It is kept until it is answered on the panel.

panel_id.name: Panels
panel_id.description: The panels' ids; none: every panel.

picture.name: Picture
picture.description: A camera entity or a picture's address, shown with the notification.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to three buttons; a press fires the panelos_notification_action event.

until_answered.name: Until answered
until_answered.description: It stays in front until it is confirmed or dismissed on the panel.
